name: motion-resume
description: 滚动节奏驱动的电影感简历生成器
interaction: As users scroll through their resume, each section unfolds like a film sequence—elements fade, slide, and scale in perfect sync with scroll velocity, creating a cinematic pacing. Key moments trigger dramatic visual effects like parallax depth shifts and letterbox transitions between career chapters. The final scroll snaps into a poster-style summary page where the entire journey is revealed as a single cinematic frame.
